definitionContract.typedCoordinates: Finite Float64 XYZ encoded as 48 lower-case hexadecimal characters per triple, little-endian.
definitionContract.retainedLinePicks: Exact finite Float32 XYZ encoded as 24 lower-case hexadecimal characters per record, little-endian. Canonical copies reject implicit rounding.
definitionContract.pickStorageTag: native-pick-record-f32 describes precision only, not coordinate space.
definitionContract.commonSources: Distinct entity IDs with canonical 16-byte order keys, strictly sorted by unsigned raw-key order. No scene lookup or identity generation occurs.
definitionContract.orderedRecords: Preserves order and repeated IDs, including IDs absent from the common source set.
definitionContract.inactiveContainers: All point modes retain common sources; all line modes retain common sources and ordered records, including numeric modes.
definitionContract.cardinality: Empty and extra retained collections are valid storage. Authoring admission is separate.
definitionContract.stateSeparation: Prior evaluated geometry, outcome diagnostics and completion word belong beside the definition, not in caller-editable recipe fields.
definitionContract.validation: Reject unknown versions/modes/fields, malformed bits, nonfinite values, noncanonical common sets and incompatible types; return detached nested values.
